_purpose: Human-declared page zones for the ANSI B v2 candidate, sheet C101 (page 2). They stand in for a person drawing boxes on the sheet: normalized page coordinates, origin top-left. They are configuration, never model output, and are validated by deterministic sanity checks (tests/test_spatial.py) such as the number of COURT labels each plan view contains.
